config.label: Session key from https://mpp32
config.description: Session key from https://mpp32.org/agent-console. Unlocks the full federated catalog and attributes every call to your dashboard. Optional in legacy mode where only native services are reachable.

config.label: Solana private key used to sign x402 USDC payments locally
config.description: Solana private key used to sign x402 USDC payments locally. Only needed when calling paid services that prefer x402. Stays on your machine, never sent to MPP32 servers.

config.label: Ethereum L2 private key used to sign Tempo pathUSD payments locally
config.description: Ethereum L2 private key used to sign Tempo pathUSD payments locally. Optional fallback for paid services when x402 is not available. Stays on your machine, never sent to MPP32 servers.

config.label: Override the API base URL for custom deployments
config.description: Override the API base URL for custom deployments. Defaults to https://mpp32.org.
